GCS CA
GCs California

Eric Railsback
Managing Director of Sales, California
eric@grandcruselections.com
About Eric
Eric Railsback’s emergence in the wine industry began taking shape in Santa Barbara nearly a decade ago. After stints at the Wine Cask and the Hungry Cat, Eric furthered his exposure to different regions and producers at Osteria Mozza and running the wine program at Gordon Ramsey in Los Angeles. He has a strong connection to the wines of France after working harvests in Burgundy at Domaine Roulot and Domaine Dujac. After Santa Barbara Eric brought his talents to Michael Mina’s RN74 – a premiere Burgundy- inspired restaurant in San Francisco. There, he led a team of sommeliers for over three years before bringing it back full circle to Santa Barbara launching Railsback Frères winery.
SALES

Tyler Stacy
Sales Manager, Northern California
Tstacy@grandcruselections.com
About Tyler
Tyler was born and raised in Solano County, California under the ominous shadow of its neighbor, Napa Valley. As a teenager, vineyards were a place to cause mischief, not a place to contemplate the mysteries of the sacred vine. His first interest in wine came while working in a humble Italian restaurant owned by Emiglia-Romagna native, Elena Corsini-Mastro, where he learned the simple pleasures of Italian culture - hand made pasta, passionate conversation and the heart of a wheel of Parmigiano Reggiano. In a never ending search for knowledge, Tyler found himself studying through the Court of Master Sommeliers program and now, more than 10 years later, he has occupied virtually every layer of the wine industry from Sommelier, to Cellar Hand, to rockstar Sales Manager. Today, Tyler lives in Sacramento, with his wife, Emily and their daughter Margot. By day he manages Grand Cru Selections throughout Wine Country and by night handles pumpovers and barrel work as winemaker and proprietor for his brand, Commune Regional Wines.

Justin Thompson
Sales Manager, Southern California
jthompson@grandcruselections.com
About Justin
Born in Los Angeles and raised in the San Francisco Bay Area, Justin grew up in a family where food and hospitality were central, and wine often on the dinner table. After a career in college athletics, he returned to Los Angeles to attend business school at the University of Southern California. After graduating with an MBA, Justin spent the next six years working in supply chain operations. Wanting to pursue his passion for wine and hospitality, Justin took a part time position working in the retail and wine bar space at Stanley’s Wet Goods in Culver City while maintaining his full time job in supply chain management. With the desire to take on hospitality full time, Justin left the world of supply chain and took on an opportunity as Wine and Beverage Manager at Jon & Vinny’s/Helen’s Wines in Los Angeles before joining the team at Grand Cru Selections. Currently residing in Manhattan Beach, Justin can often be found on his off hours cooking dinner for friends or sipping a Pacifico at a local South Bay dive.

Meghan Mcdonnell
Account Manager, San Francisco/South Bay
mmcdonnell@grandcruselections.com
About Meghan
It was through making cappuccinos during college in Madison, Wisconsin at a cafe aptly called Barriques that Meghan realized wine could be a full-time career. Once that secret was revealed, it was off to explore all the jobs that exist in wine. Opportunities in the industry have brought her from fine dining restaurants in Chicago and Las Vegas to harvest in Sonoma. She spent several years in New York City, where a highlight of her career was being the Chef Sommelier for the Grand Award-winning list at Nice Matin. An opportunity arose to move out west, where she ran Verve Wine in San Francisco for several years before most recently joining the Grand Cru team. When Meghan’s not selling wine, she is probably drinking it while doing the NYT crossword, listening to jazz, and cooking up something new.

Elliot Lawler
Account Manager, Central Coast/Monterey
elawler@grandcruselections.com
About Elliot
Born and raised in the San Francisco Bay Area, Elliot spent much of his childhood in a family friend’s Italian deli where he developed a passion for food, learned the value of great hospitality and eventually how wine combined to complete the picture. This interest blossomed during his college years, leading him to pursue a Bachelor of Science in Enology and Viticulture from Cal Poly, San Luis Obispo. After graduating, he spent the next five years working with producers in New Zealand, Australia, France, and back here on the West Coast in California and Oregon before taking a long-term role as assistant winemaker and sales director for a boutique label here on the Central Coast. Elliot and his partner, Shelby, now call Santa Barbara home and he is excited to have come on board on the Grand Cru Selections California team.

Matt Bone
Account Manager, San Diego County
mbone@grandcruselections.com
About Matt
Matt’s passion for hospitality (and later wine) began two decades ago in a St. Louis suburb when he landed his first job bussing tables at Alfonzo’s Pizzeria. After studying at Illinois Wesleyan University, Matt moved to Los Angeles and followed his passion for food and drink into the hospitality industry. Matt worked for over a decade in Los Angeles restaurants starting as a bartender and ending as a wine director; most notably at restaurants Hatchet Hall and Greekman’s. In 2021 Matt, his wife Randi, daughter Mara, and dog George relocated to San Diego. When not visiting Grand Cru Selections accounts all over San Diego County, Matt is either playing with Mara at the park, walking the dog, or proselytizing about the importance of farming in winemaking.

Kelly Eckel
Account Manager, Napa/Sonoma/Mendocino
keckel@grandcruselections.com
About Kelly
Kelly was raised on Long Island, New York. After graduating from Marist College, he began his wine career in sales at Young’s Fine Market in Manhasset, where he was first exposed to the breadth of the wine world. He later spent a year in Walla Walla, Washington working in wine production. Drawn by a love of the outdoors, Kelly moved to Lake Tahoe, California to pursue his favorite pastime—skiing. It was there that a culinary path took shape, and after a decade working as a sushi chef, the seed planted during his early wine career began to grow again. He eventually relocated to Sonoma County to pursue a sommelier position at the acclaimed SingleThread Farms, later joining Harbor House as Beverage Director in 2023. After many incredible sunsets on the Mendocino coast, Kelly is now helping make dreams come true at Grand Cru Selections. When he’s not preparing for a GCS tasting, Kelly can usually be found hiking, cheering on Liverpool FC or dreaming about Burgundy. He loves talking about wine — so please don’t hesitate to ask questions.

Jerald Armstrong
Account Manager, Los Angeles
jarmstrong@grandcruselections.com
About Jerald
Born and raised on the West Coast, Jerald was what the restaurant industry calls a “lifer.” After a couple of decades at iconic restaurants like Cafe Juanita in Kirkland, WA, Blackbird in Chicago, and Chez Panisse and Osteria Mozza in California, he made the jump into distribution in Seattle, officially ending his restaurant “lifer” status. Having worked with the Grand Cru and Vom Boden books in the Pacific Northwest, joining the team felt like a natural fit when he returned to Los Angeles.
When he’s not visiting his accounts on the Westside, Jerald loves cooking dinner for friends and spending weekends away with his husband and their dogs, Reuben and Shirley.
Dan Lundin
Account Manager, East Los Angeles
DLundin@grandcruselections.com
About Dan
“Give me books, French wine, fruit, fine weather and a little music played out of doors by somebody I do not know.” —John Keats
Dan is a byproduct of the West Coast — born in Seattle, raised in Dana Point and capped and gowned at UCLA before landing in San Francisco after college. Unsure of a particular career path, he wanted to keep learning without returning to the classroom and had no intention of abandoning fun. Fortunately, San Francisco offered a romantic and expansive alternative: wine.
And so, without much more thought than that, off he went: wine shop, distributor, marketing agency, move back to LA, supplier, distributor. After Distributor No. 2, Dan and a partner made the sober decision to buy a small business. They didn’t run it into the ground, eventually sold it and, more eventually, Dan returned to the grapes: Napa winery, distributor, move to Colorado, distributor, move back to LA—and here we are: Grand Cru Selections. Cue the band!

Bryan Schlessel
Account Manager, SF/Marin/East Bay
About Bryan
Bryan grew up in Alabama and has called California home for the past 15 years. He began his career in hospitality, working just about every front-of-house position along the way, from cocktail bars to Michelin-starred restaurants. He later joined Jenny & François Selections, where he developed a passion for independent importers and grower-driven wines.
At Grand Cru Selections, Bryan is excited to reconnect with his fine dining roots, working with restaurants and sommeliers who share his appreciation for exceptional wine while representing a portfolio of world-class producers.

Grand Cru Selections
Grand Cru Selections
GCS NY/NJ

Robert Bohr
About Robert
Robert leads Grand Cru Selections as a 20 plus year veteran in the New York City hospitality business. He entered the restaurant business at 13, but it wasn’t until college, working his way through New York University at Gramercy Tavern, that he decided that a career in wine was more interesting than becoming a lawyer. He went on to play an integral part of the incubation of several new wine programs including Babbo, Nick & Toni’s and CRU Restaurant. During these years, he found his passion for Burgundy while perfecting his fine-dining skills. Robert expanded his Old World palate with work as a wine buyer at Zachys, where he oversaw acquisitions from Burgundy, Germany, and Champagne. Following the successful launch of three popular New York City restaurants: Charlie Bird, Pasquale Jones and Legacy Records, Robert teamed up with his long-time industry wine partner, Ned Benedict, to launch Grand Cru Selections with the goal of growing a meaningful and sustainable business for their clients and family of growers.
Robert serves on the board of No Kid Hungry’s The Monday Fund, an organization with a goal of ending childhood hunger in the United States. He lives in Paris with his wife, Jordan, and their two boys Henry and Ronan.

Elise Pfannenstiel
About Elise
Elise was born and raised in Kansas City, Mo, an only child and avid reader she made her way to Grinnell College in Iowa to study literature. After college she moved to New York City and began working as a server and bartender in both Brooklyn and Manhattan. After meeting Robert Bohr in 2002 and following his advice, she began working at Washington Park and soon after opened Cru which began a whirlwind education in fine wine. After a two year hiatus in Westhampton Beach, Elise returned to NYC, only to work once again with Robert. In 2009 she helped form Grand Cru Selections. As one of the founding members, she is proud to have been part of the journey and progression of the company from day one and is excited to see what the future holds.

Heather Whitney
Chief of Staff
heather@grandcruselections.com
About Heather
As the Chief of Staff for Grand Cru Selections, Heather supports Robert and the team with special projects. Prior to joining GCS, Heather's career spanned more than two decades with New York City's Union Square Hospitality Group. Her most recent role was Director of Special Events and Partnerships at The Modern, in association with The Museum of Modern Art. During her tenure, Heather and her team were responsible for creating over 5000 memorable events. Outside of work, Heather enjoys gardening, cycling and paddle boarding.
Sales & Hospitality

Jay Latham
Senior Managing Director of Sales & Inventory
jay@grandcruselections.com
About Jay
Jay grew up in Natchez, Mississippi where the import section at the local store was a choice between Grolsch and Molson beer. A regular childhood highlight was crossing the Mississippi River over to Louisiana for frog legs at a local creole joint and frequent family trips to New Orleans for its restaurants. Fast forward a few years to college in Tennessee where Jay joined the restaurant tribe working at a small bistro owned by a couple that would become life long mentors and friends. Armed with their encouragement, a liberal arts degree, and some old wine books, Jay moved to San Francisco twenty years ago and started working in a wine shop where he immediately fell down the rabbit holes of Piedmont, the Rhone, and most importantly Burgundy. He soon met Martine Saunier who brought him over to the side of imports and into the cellars of France. Jay joined Grand Cru Selections in 2015 and could not be more proud to work with this talented team for these exceptional growers.

Mike Papaleo
Managing Director of Sales - NY/NJ
MPapaleo@grandcruselections.com
About Mike
Originally from Greater Chicagoland and armed with a BA in Theatre Arts, Mike spent his early years in New York performing far off Broadway and waiting tables at several restaurants that have since closed their doors. His path into fine wine began at Michael White’s acclaimed Fiamma Osteria, where a bottle of 1988 Montevertine Le Pergole Torte proved transformative.
Mike went on to deepen his wine knowledge through roles at Morrell, Liberty Wine Selections and Lieb Cellars before taking on significant roles at Banville Wine Merchants and Wilson Daniels. He now lives in Sea Cliff, New York, with his wife, Maggie, and their two daughters.

Photo Courtesy of William Thomas Photography
Abby Oliveras
Director of National Sales - East
aoliveras@grandcruselections.com
About Abby
Abby Oliveras grew up in restaurants in Connecticut, often folding napkins or polishing silverware in exchange for Shirley Temples. In 2008 she moved to New York City and began her career in fine dining working at every restaurant she could find with "Grill" in the name including Tribeca Grill, Gotham Bar & Grill, The Grill, and countless other exciting but short lived restaurants without grills across the city. Eventually she gave up the restaurant life and became the Brand Ambassador for Skurnik Wines Champagne, German, and Austrian Portfolio, traveling the country and educating customers and consumers on the importance of acidity and minerality. Abby joined Grand Cru in 2024 and is thrilled to work with such a great team and represent so many incredible growers.

Rick Pitcher
Director of National Sales - West
rpitcher@grandcruselections.com
About Rick
Rick grew up in Central New York in a family where food and wine were always central to daily life. His introduction to fine wine came early, when his father entered the wine import business, working with renowned estates in Burgundy, Bordeaux, and California. Although Rick initially pursued a path in finance at the University of Massachusetts Amherst, he quickly recognized that his true interests lay elsewhere. He transitioned into the university’s acclaimed hospitality program, setting the foundation for a career in the restaurant and wine world.
Rick moved to New York City, where he spent over two decades working in some of the city’s top restaurants, holding roles in both operations and as a wine director. Along the way, he built lasting relationships with many colleagues who are now part of the Grand Cru team.
In 2016, Rick relocated to Austin, Texas, where he expanded his experience into wine distribution, working with companies of varying scale while continuing to collaborate with growers who are now part of the Grand Cru portfolio. Joining Grand Cru Selections marks a full-circle moment—bringing together his early influences, professional journey, and long-standing relationships. He is energized to be part of the team and proud to represent a portfolio of exceptional producers.

Rocky Gray
Account Manager & Social Media
rocky@grandcruselections.com
About Rocky
Four decades ago Rocky was born in Korea to a non-wine drinking household. Her parents still do not understand what she does for a living. After partying out of Vassar, she found herself like many a young folk waiting tables in NYC. She has worked at Cru, Gotham Bar & Grill, L’impero and Le Bernardin (as well as a brief mid-life crisis stint working in International Tax at Ernst & Young). Rocky sold all of her bitcoins too early and will be at GCS for the foreseeable future. She is enormously grateful to be working with the best team and growers, and drinking the finest wines in all the land.

Rachel Kerswell
Account Manager
rkerswell@grandcruselections.com
About Rachel
Born and raised on the west coast of Canada, the countryside was simply second nature to Rachel. It wasn’t until she relocated to Montreal at seventeen that she fell into service and hospitality. A passion derived from language, travel, culture, food and wine. Rachel began her wine career in 2010 when hired to run the beverage program at a quaint but fast-paced restaurant called L’Orignal. After a couple wonderful years, she left the winter behind and move to Southern California. Throughout the next few years she would work as a sommelier at some of Los Angeles’ and New York City’s top Beverage Programs; including Osteria Mozza, République and The NoMad Hotel.
Though restaurants were a way of life, an opportunity impossible to pass up in imports and distribution was introduced in 2015. Since then she hasn't looked back.

Kyle McShane Griffin
Account Manager
kyle@grandcruselections.com
About Kyle
Kyle grew up in Denver, CO. When it was time for college he enrolled at Colorado State where he began his study of fermented beverages starting with beer. Occasionally he attended class. To pay for his new hobby, he got a job bussing tables at an Italian restaurant. To this day, he will tell you that the best two jobs in restaurants are bussing tables and serving fancy wine. He eventually graduated. Little is known about the five years following college, but eventually he turned up in New York City. Soon after arriving, he took a job at a new restaurant called Charlie Bird. The combination of hip hop and fine wine suited him well, and after two years, he went on to open its sister restaurants -- Pasquale Jones and Legacy Records, during which the focus shifted fully to wine. Over the course of these years he became friendly with the Grand Cru Selections people and wine, so after three restaurant openings in a row, taking a job at GCS seemed like the perfect next step.

Yumiko Munekyo
Sake Specialist
yumiko@grandcruselections.com
About Yumiko
Yumiko was born and grew up in Japan. When she was 15 years old, she became a foreign exchange student and spent a year in California. She was amazed to see the U.S. culture and promised herself to come back. After she graduated from college in Tokyo, she joined Goldman Sachs to work on a trading floor and that brought her to New York in 2011 and she worked for Nomura Securities till 2015. She launched a sake importing company, Sake Suki in 2013. There were not many craft sake found in NY back then. She missed drinking her local craft sake so much and that became the motivation of importing. The first container arrived in 2016 and joined GCS right after. Her passion is to introduce small but beautiful craft sake producers to you!

Rachel Durboraw
Account Manager
rachel@grandcruselections.com
About Rachel
Born in California and raised in North Carolina, food and hospitality was an early passion for Rachel. While kitchens were always a familiar place she discovered her interest in wine while studying at the Culinary Institute of America. After graduating she worked in the dining room at The Modern for 3 years before leaving to open Restaurant Gabriel Kreuther in 2015 as the Service Director. She joined the GCS team in the summer of 2021 and is enjoying the process of adding a whole new set of tools and tricks to her hospitality repertoire. When not sipping wine or cooking with friends she likes to spend time in her garden or taking trips to local farms where she fantasizes about raising chickens and goats.

Clifford Bell
Account Manager, New Jersey/Westchester
cbell@grandcruselections.com
About Clifford
Clifford was born and raised in New Jersey, where he grew up working in his family's seafood restaurant. With dreams of becoming a lawyer, he headed to Gettysburg College to study political science. It was during a semester in Provence that he discovered a passion for wine, and what was supposed to be a quick stint at a wine bar between college and law school quickly turned into something much more. Nearly five years later, Clifford considers it the best decision he’s ever made.
His time at Cree Wine Company gave him the opportunity to deepen his knowledge of wine while discovering many exciting growers, including many whose wines are represented by Grand Cru Selections. That experience made joining Grand Cru a natural next step, allowing Clifford to continue building relationships with producers, restaurants, retailers and wine lovers while sharing the wines and people that have made the world of wine so compelling to him.
Education and Grower Relations

Thomas Pastuszak
Senior Managing Director of Strategy & Communications
thomas@grandcruselections.com
About Thomas
Born & bred in New York, Thomas studied neurobiology and classical piano at Cornell University, and all the while worked in restaurants to pay-off his student loans. In January 2011, Thomas diverted from his path toward a medical career, and took on the role of Wine Director at Chef Tom Colicchio’s restaurant Colicchio & Sons in New York City, and would soon thereafter join the team behind world-renowned Eleven Madison Park to create The NoMad in Spring 2012. He opened The NoMad as its Wine Director & helped it achieve its 3-Star New York Times rating within a few months of its opening, later moving into the role of Executive Wine Director of all of the NoMad properties. In the years since, Thomas was chosen as a Best New Sommelier by Wine & Spirits Magazine, recognized as one of Forbes' 30 Under 30, and was named one of Food & Wine’s Sommeliers of the Year. Additionally, Thomas has gotten into the world of winemaking, launching three exciting new wine labels: Terrassen in 2013, Empire Estate in 2014, and VINNY in 2018, all with a focus on New York's rising upstate wine region, the Finger Lakes. Thomas joined Grand Cru Selections in the Summer of 2021 as its VP of Sales & Hospitality, excited to bring his passion & experience in the wine & restaurant industry over to the world of imports & distribution, through the lens of the exciting portfolio that Grand Cru Selections has grown & curated over its years in business.

Angela Cotton
Director of Communications & Italian Grower Relations
angela@grandcruselections.com
About Angela
Angela was born and raised in Boulder, Colorado. While studying Journalism and Italian at the University of Colorado she wanted to further her education in old world wine and sought out a position with local italophile and hospitalian Bobby Stuckey at Frasca Food&Wine. Not long after graduating, Angela took off to work harvest in Napa Valley and set her sights on Thomas Keller’s French Laundry, working through the ranks to become a Captain. Years later, she was offered a position at Keller's Per Se in NYC in 2013. One winter, Angela booked a solo voyage to Europe where she trampled through cellars in Burgundy and serendipitously met her now-husband, a winemaker. She moved to Italy in 2015, first to work at a historic restaurant in Turin in Piedmont before landing a position for a Strategic Communications Agency in Florence. In her 6 year tenure, she worked with some of the most important names in Italian wine and hospitality, honing skills in bilingual but also bi-cultural communication. She’s well practiced in the art of Italian complications and has mastered the language (with a slightly Tuscan accent!), which tends to help

A Wine Importer is responsible for sourcing and bringing wines from international producers into a specific market or country. This involves building relationships with wineries, negotiating contracts, handling logistics and customs regulations, and ensuring compliance with local laws. Importers may work with distributors, retailers, or directly with consumers to market and sell their selections. Their role requires knowledge of wine, global markets, and international trade regulations.
Wine Importers typically manage a diverse range of tasks, including sourcing wines from international producers, coordinating shipments, ensuring compliance with import regulations, and negotiating contracts with suppliers and distributors. One common challenge is keeping up with changing import laws, tariffs, and customs documentation requirements in various countries, which requires attention to detail and adaptability. Importers often work closely with logistics, sales, and marketing teams to ensure efficient delivery and successful market entry. This role demands strong organizational skills as well as the ability to cultivate lasting relationships with overseas partners and clients.
To thrive as a Wine Importer, you need strong knowledge of global wine regions, international trade regulations, and supply chain logistics, often supported by experience in the wine industry or import/export sector. Familiarity with customs compliance software, logistics management systems, and relevant certifications such as WSET (Wine & Spirit Education Trust) can be highly beneficial. Negotiation skills, cultural awareness, and the ability to build strong relationships are key soft skills in this role. These skills ensure you can source quality products, navigate complex import requirements, and develop valuable supplier and client partnerships.
